subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Immigrete**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Immigrete"** is incorrectly spelt and does not have a meaning in English. The correct spelling is **"Immigrate"**. (प्रवासी होना)
 
• **Immigrate** refers to the act of coming to live permanently in a foreign country. (प्रवासी होना)
 
 
• **Example: **She decided to immigrate to Canada after getting a job offer there.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Immigrete**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Professional** (पेशेवर): Relating to or connected with a profession.

 
 
• **Example:** She is a professional dancer who has performed all over the world.
 
 
 
• **Combat** (लड़ाई): Fighting between armed forces.
 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers were trained in hand-to-hand combat.
 
 
 
• **Relevant** (प्रासंगिक): Closely connected or appropriate to what is being done or considered.
 
 
• **Example:** His comments were not relevant to the topic we were discussing.
